The initiative, currently being rolled out in the Chaudière-Appalaches region, allows eligible individuals to collect their own samples using a swab and transport tube, which are then sent to medical clinics or test centers. The Health Ministry and Santé Québec have requested that hospitals and regions across the province make self-sampling available next year. Positive results require further testing, such as a pelvic exam or colposcopy, to determine if cancerous or precancerous changes are present. The program is covered by RAMQ, and while no provincewide rollout date has been confirmed, Salvador, a gynecologic oncologist, hopes it will be available across Quebec by early to mid-2027. title: JAM3 and PAX1 Gene Methylation Tracks Cervical Lesion Severity in Hospital Study - Bioengineer.org

analysis.time: The study was conducted between September 2024 and December 2025, with the news published on November 26, 2026.
analysis.location_and_population: The research was carried out at the Gynecologic Oncology Center of the Affiliated Cancer Hospital of Xinjiang Medical University, involving 205 treatment-negative women aged 25 years or older with confirmed baseline high-risk HPV positivity.
analysis.event: A hospital-based observational study found that DNA methylation of host genes JAM3 and PAX1 is significantly associated with increasing histological severity of cervical lesions among women with high-risk HPV infections. The study was reported by Bioengineer.org on November 26, 2026.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: The study analyzed 205 women, classified into five histological groups: 5 normal cases, 51 CIN1, 36 CIN2, 70 CIN3, and 43 invasive cervical cancer cases. Methylation positivity rates increased with lesion severity, reaching 65.12% in cervical cancer cases. HPV16 was the most prevalent strain at 59.05%, followed by HPV52 (14.29%), HPV58 (13.33%), and HPV18 (6.67%).
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The study was conducted as an observational analysis with rigorous inclusion/exclusion criteria. It used multivariable modeling and statistical tests (Cochran-Armitage trend test, ordinal logistic regression) to assess associations. The findings are based on histopathological diagnoses and methylation testing, with no mention of ongoing public health response or uncertainty about the results.

analysis.brief_en: A hospital-based study conducted at the Gynecologic Oncology Center of the Affiliated Cancer Hospital of Xinjiang Medical University found that DNA methylation of host genes JAM3 and PAX1 is significantly associated with increasing histological severity of cervical lesions among women with high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) infections. The research, published on November 26, 2026, evaluated 205 treatment-negative women aged 25 or older, classified into five histological groups: normal tissue, cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) grades 1-3, and invasive cervical cancer. Methylation positivity rates rose from 20% in normal cases to 65.12% in cervical cancer, with HPV16 being the most prevalent strain. The study highlights the potential of JAM3/PAX1 methylation as an objective biomarker for improving risk stratification in cervical cancer detection, as standalone HPV16/18 genotyping showed limited diagnostic accuracy compared to combined methylation testing. The findings suggest a need for further research to integrate these molecular markers into clinical practice for better patient outcomes.

source_language_evidence.brief_en: 新闻 体育 汽车 房产 旅游 教育 时尚 科技 财经 娱乐 HPV疫苗系列科普(十一)| HPV疫苗≠只防宫颈癌!这些疾病也能抵挡 2026-11-24 16:36 来源: 中部城市生活指南 发布于:北京市 提起HPV疫苗,很多人的第一印象就是“宫颈癌疫苗”。不少人认为,它的作用仅仅是保护宫颈。事实上,HPV病毒不只是会感染宫颈,还可以感染外阴、阴道、肛门、口腔、咽喉、阴茎等多处黏膜皮肤,持续感染后可能诱发多种病变和癌症。HPV疫苗的防护范围远比大家想象的更广,是一种面向男女都有健康收益的疫苗。 人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)是一类主要感染人体皮肤和黏膜上皮的球形DNA病毒,大约有200多种亚型。大多数HPV感染是无症状的,可自行消除,但持续感染HPV可能导致疾病发生。研究显示,在至少有一名异性伴侣的人群中,女性一生中感染HPV的概率为84.6%,男性为91.3%[1]。 HPV的致病性 HPV依据其致癌潜力可分为高危型和低危型两大类。 在高危型HPV中, 16型和18型是致癌能力最强的两个亚型,大约造成全球70%的宫颈癌,同时还可能诱发阴道癌、肛门癌、阴茎癌等多种恶性肿瘤。 低危型HPV通常引起良性病变,常见的型别有6型和11型,占生殖器疣病因的90%[2]。 二价HPV疫苗(16、18型): 可预防约70%宫颈癌,也可预防由16、18型 HPV病毒导致的外阴癌、阴道癌、肛门癌、口咽癌、阴茎癌以及对应的癌前病变。 四价HPV疫苗(6、11、16、18型): 可预防约70%宫颈癌+90%生殖器疣。拥有二价全部防护能力,额外预防尖锐湿疣、复发性呼吸道乳头状瘤病。
